mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that may prompt central bank intervention, leading to positive equity returns as investors anticipate policy support over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100), manufacturing activity expansion signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO is above 100, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity, which correlates with broader economic health and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is above 1.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units, it signals a strong housing market that correlates with overall economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1200, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
